scope: High-resolution sliced neural symbol detection and public real-data expansion. Port/junction neural model and Relationformer are later independent comparisons, not claimed implemented here.
policy: v5 Virden/Ruttan test pages are now explicitly training data and cannot be reported as unseen. New-page test belongs to known training projects, not independent unseen projects. Annotate ROIs and freeze labels before neural prediction. Single annotator, limited ROIs. Never use tested-page labels for training or threshold selection.
method: YOLOX-Nano object detector, COCO pretrained weights, CPU fine-tuning, bounded overlap tiles preserving original detail; v5 remains baseline; select runtime variant on validation only.

checkpoint_selection.objective: mean over validation source groups(connection F1 +0.25 localization F1)
checkpoint_selection.policy: Select only after all7 validation sheets complete; no new-page predictions inspected. High-resolution tile1024 / overlap20% / model640 fixed.
